name: json_transform
description: Parse, query, and transform JSON data. Supports JSONPath queries, formatting, merging, and schema validation.

manual.overview: Use when you need to parse, query, transform, or validate JSON. Supports JSONPath, formatting, merging, and schema validation.

examples.description: Extract all user names via JSONPath

tips: Use action=format for pretty-printing; action=query for JSONPath extraction
Data can be a JSON string or file path
Merge and validate require schema/query for correct behavior
Escape quotes in embedded JSON strings
edge_cases: Invalid JSON in data string will fail parsing
JSONPath syntax may differ by implementation; test expressions
Large JSON files can consume memory; consider streaming for big data

executor.command: python -c "import json, os, sys; data_in='{{args.data}}'; d=json.loads(data_in) if data_in.strip().startswith('{') else json.load(open(data_in)); print(json.dumps(d, indent=2))"
